boards.label: kiwi follower/slave ESP32-S3
boards.notes: User reported this currently connected board is the follower/slave. Motors are wired to D0/GPIO1, D1/GPIO2, D2/GPIO3. The second Dominion's unused channel input is wired to D3/GPIO4 and must be fed 1500 us or that ESC never arms (both channels of a Dominion need a valid centered pulse). Bench result 2026-07-02: all three motors spin; the D0 motor needs roughly 1850 us to overcome friction while D1/D2 move at 1650 us. Inter-board UART is not wired yet; no encoders installed (I2C mux absent).
